Let us close by remarking that many extremal results about cycles in graphs ought to have natural generalisations formulated in terms of triangulations of spheres in hypergraphs. We shall resist the temptation to list further open problems of this kind here, although we would certainly be very interested to see more results of this nature. Perhaps the main message of this paper is that it is possible to do ‘extremal simplicial topology’ with a flavour similar to extremal graph theory, and that some of the major techniques in the latter field, like regularity and absorption, can be brought to bear on the former.
